An '''individual''' was the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Minister of Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Minister of Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was immediately under the [[Dark Council]]or and head of the [[Sphere of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Darth Jadus]]; later he served in the same position under [[Darth Zhorrid]] but at the end of the [[Hunt for the Eagle]], he was considered compromised and was replaced by [[Minister of Intelligence (Galactic War)|the former]] [[Keeper (Imperial Intelligence)|Keeper]].
